source.fingerprintMethod: sha256 of ordered path, NUL, binary sha256(file) tuples

reproduction.seed: Native package installed and loaded; actual HTTP/WebSocket/PTY/file tool passed.
reproduction.replacementBeforeFix: Package missing after first container removed and second created with the same named data volume; model configuration was still present.
reproduction.cause: Native global OMP package root is independent of agentDir and defaulted to /home/node/.omp outside /data.

changes: Docker links /home/node/.omp to /data/omp-native; preserves native path selection while persisting personal packages, caches and global state. App OMP configuration/history stay under /data/pi-harness/omp.
Non-root image entrypoint creates the native target directory on existing non-empty volumes, then delegates to the standard Node entrypoint. No startup chown or old-data deletion.
Remove unused PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR image override and old /data/pi-agent creation; document real application/config/native directories and explicit old-container recovery boundaries.
Use Debian official HTTPS for JDK downloads after original HTTP downloads failed; target native dependencies are still installed on Linux, not copied from macOS.
Exclude local agent state and package credentials from Docker build context.

CLI help, service environment and systemd description/template use OMP app data directory; explicit --data-dir overrides inherited PI_WEB_DATA_DIR. New service configs omit obsolete Pi directory override.
Add explicit Docker CI job; native container test remains outside default smoke because it requires local Docker. Add service-generation test to smoke, current default list 122.
coverage: Image USER=node / uid=1000 and default production command, actual HTTP and WebSocket initialization, native read/task availability and absent retired Pi tool names.
Real locally served npm extension installed by production OMP package worker, loaded in the actual session before and after container replacement.
Two separate containers using the same owned volume, physical native package root under /data, preserved models.yml and native session ID/history, renewed runtime conversation handle.
Real model fixture receives native file-read result, no forced 128000 output limit, zero model requests during restoration, actual PTY command output and clean terminal exit in both containers.
No external network in fixture containers; no real credentials or project mounts. Containers and volumes created with UUID ownership labels and deleted only after identity verification.

CLI help and six dry-run service configurations (three platform generation branches, environment versus explicit data directory); external commands and filesystem mutation APIs rejected by test preload.

Existing non-empty volume lacking the new native directory: initial symlink-only candidate reproduced ENOENT; final entrypoint creates the directory as uid 1000 and preserves the old sentinel across both application containers.
intermediateFixtureCorrection: Initial restore assertion incorrectly required the ephemeral host conversationId to survive. OmpClientSession.createChat always generates a new handle; final regression verifies stable native sessionId/history with a new runtime handle. Package retention assertions were kept.
limitations: Local Linux arm64 image verification, not Linux desktop, Windows, x64, real gateway or real account acceptance. CI job added but not remotely executed.
No final full 122-entry smoke rerun; latest full baseline is separate earlier 120/120 (omp-smoke-task-output.json).
Native Task internal writer guard, OAuth write-back/tool-level auth, native CLI JSON/print exit, original Windows DeepSeek task and current desktop package acceptance remain.
Service test executes dry-run generation branches; it never installs launchd/systemd/Windows tasks.
No active old desktop history was cleared or application replaced.
